description: This file implements the AppUserReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve user data, search templates, and new user details within the Fineract platform. It handles database interactions for fetching user information, role data, and linking related staff and client details, utilizing Spring Framework features like caching and JdbcTemplate.

classes.name: AppUserMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps SQL result set rows to AppUserData objects, fetching role and staff details for each user.

classes.name: AppUserLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for fetching minimal user details needed for dropdown or search templates.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current PlatformSecurityContext instance; used for caching in Spring.

methods.name: retrieveAllUsers
methods.description: Retrieves all users accessible under the current user's office hierarchy, utilizing custom SQL and mapping.

methods.name: retrieveSearchTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a simplified list of users for search/autocomplete features.

methods.name: retrieveNewUserDetails
methods.description: Provides templates for creating a new user, including available offices and roles.

methods.name: retrieveUser
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific user by ID, including roles, linked staff, and clients if self-service.

methods.name: isUsernameExist
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists in the system.
